ValidationRule.description: Restricts Marketing Users from updating the Lead Owner until the Lead reaches the Qualified stage.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(OwnerId), $Profile.Name = "Carlton Marketing User", NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status, "Engage")), OwnerId <> $User.Id, NOT($CustomMetadata.Trigger_Framework_Config_CC__mdt.Lead.Bypass_Validation_CC__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A Lead can only be reassigned to Sales once it has been Engaged by Marketing.
